findings.title: Invalid CSV and symlink-loop config escape the fixed protocol error boundary
findings.contract_impact: The fixed entry must emit exactly one ARGO_HP_RESULT with safe enum text. csv.Error and RuntimeError are not converted to EntryError, so controlled invalid inputs produce a Python traceback with host paths and no protocol result.
evidence: NF-01: malformed quoted features.csv exited 1 with _csv.Error: unexpected end of data; ARGO_HP_RESULT was absent.
NF-02: a local_runs_root symlink loop exited 1 with RuntimeError: Symlink loop and exposed the temporary absolute path; ARGO_HP_RESULT was absent.
findings.required_fix: Catch csv.Error at both strict CSV parse sites. Convert Path.resolve symlink-loop RuntimeError at the canonical-directory boundary to EntryError. Keep the public error payload enum-only.

findings.title: A valid finite dev prediction can bypass terminal receipt publication; SCORER_ERROR is unreachable
findings.contract_impact: The frozen receipt schema admits SCORER_ERROR. The implementation copies only result.status from RunStatus and converts every later GradingError to ENTRY_INVALID. A container-success run can therefore end without runner-receipt.json.
evidence: NF-05 used exact IDs and valid finite predictions 1e32. The value passes _validate_prediction_number, but dev public metric formatting rejects MAE above MAX_DEV_MAE. main emitted ENTRY_INVALID and runner_receipt_exists=False.
findings.required_fix: Handle dev grading/public-metric failure after the runner as the frozen terminal SCORER_ERROR receipt with null metric and fields consistent with the receipt schema. Do not collapse it to an entry/config error.

findings.title: Post-run log counters accept unbounded and internally inconsistent runner claims
findings.contract_impact: The adapter checks only exact-int/nonnegative shape. It does not enforce the fixed aggregate log bound or consistency of logs_truncated, so a malformed runner result becomes trusted receipt data.
evidence: NF-04 returned TIMEOUT with stdout_bytes=10**100 and logs_truncated=False. execute_entry accepted it and wrote runner-receipt.json (101 decimal digits).
findings.required_fix: Validate stdout_bytes+stderr_bytes against the exact bounded overshoot possible from the hash-bound _PipeCounter, and validate logs_truncated/status consistency before receipt construction.

findings.title: Selected-code staging leaks RuntimeError instead of SELECTED_CODE_INVALID for a symlink loop
findings.contract_impact: The selected staging API promises StagingError with fixed safe text. Path.resolve(strict=True) can raise RuntimeError, but the exception mapping omits it.
evidence: NF-03 on an exact staging.py copy caught exception_type=RuntimeError and safe_staging_error=False.
findings.required_fix: Convert the narrow resolution RuntimeError to StagingError, or replace resolution with the already-required nofollow directory traversal and identity comparison.

findings.title: The trusted local-runs/cwd relationship is path-equality checked but not device/inode bound
findings.contract_impact: The frozen contract explicitly rejects cwd matching that lacks device/inode checks. _canonical_dir discards its lstat identity, and cwd.parent.parent != local_root compares only canonical Path values.
evidence: Static source check: no fstat/lstat identity comparison connects cwd to an opened local_runs_root/<run_uuid>/repo traversal. File bindings are strong, but they do not prove this directory relationship.
findings.required_fix: Without changing the API, open local_runs_root, the UUID child, and repo with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW and dir_fd traversal; compare the final (st_dev, st_ino) to the cwd identity before and after validation.

verified_controls: All six reviewed files matched the request hashes before and after execution.
Strict config field equality, duplicate-key rejection, fixed limits, and bounded config/input/solution reads are present.
final_refit forbids a targets binding and does not compute a metric; only train.csv with its approved training target and features.csv are staged for the container.
On SUCCESS, predictions are reopened, hash/size/mtime-bound, exact-ID ordered, and checked for finite bounded numeric lexemes before any dev grade.
The candidate solution bytes are staged as solution.py and are never imported on the host by this adapter.
Output run-directory collision and runner-receipt publication use fail-closed/exclusive operations; no duplicate-publication defect was found.
read_selected_code uses the frozen final-solution.py name, checks supplied root device/inode, and delegates exact regular-single-link bounded/hash reads to read_bound.

verify_dev_receipt enforces strict schema and equality against ExpectedDevExecution, reopens prediction/ID/target bindings, recomputes exact Fraction MAE, and constructs DevResultReceipt only afterward.
boundary_notes: ExpectedDevExecution provenance independence is a caller/bridge obligation. The current unit test constructs receipt fields from the same ExpectedDevExecution, so it proves comparison mechanics, not independent native derivation. This is recorded as the known bridge gate, not a new receipt_store defect.
DirectoryIdentity provenance is likewise supplied by the trusted bridge. The staging helper checks it but cannot prove how the caller obtained it.
No claim is made about hostile whole-host isolation. F-05 is limited to the explicit frozen cwd identity requirement under the A2 cooperating-tool boundary.
Production command, real-data frozen config, immutable commit/source digest fan-in, and local OAuth remain external pending conditions; they were not reclassified as local adapter bugs.
